text:
leo: Heads up — apiserver latency spike in eu-west1 starting ~08:15. Saw leader election noise too.
maria: seeing lots of WATCH backlog on control-plane, controller-manager OOMKilled twice.
ajay: GPU attach requests timing out, kubelet logs show 504s to nvproxy, but network to GPU pool looks fine.
leo: suspecting host-level egress shaping; we recently rolled out an eBPF QoS policy on nodes to limit bursty telemetry.
emily: @leo can you paste the apiserver logs?
leo: paste: 
```
I0318 08:15:12.123456 1 wrap.go:42] GET /api/v1/namespaces?timeout=32s 500 452ms
I0318 08:15:14.654321 1 watch.go:85] watch chan blocked for 31s, backlog=8723
E0318 08:15:16.000000 1 controller_manager.go:214] failed to sync: reconciler timeout
```
maria: also seeing raft leader heartbeats delayed: etcd logs show apply latency spikes correlated to NIC drop counters.
ajay: ran tcpdump on one affected node: lots of retransmits to our NAT gateway IP, flows stuck in RTO.
leo: `sudo tc qdisc show dev eth0` shows clsact + fq maybe misclassifying high-priority controlplane traffic.
emily: any recent change in egress routes or NAT? ops-bot: deployment/egress-shim rolled 3 hosts in eu-west1 at 08:10 by infra-pipeline.
ajay: rollback candidate: revert eBPF QoS policy or add a bypass for ports 6443/2379/2380. Which is safer?
maria: temporary bypass for 6443/2379 would be lower risk. Controller-manager needs watch events asap.
leo: creating canary iptables rule on node-05 to exempt controlplane IPs from shaping. Will monitor.
(2m later) leo: adding rule — watch backlog falling from 8.7k -> 800 in 90s. leader election noise calming. :thumbsup:
emily: GPU attach rate returned to normal on node-05, other nodes still degraded.
ajay: we should mark the eBPF policy as suspect and pause rollout. Opening rollout-blocker tag on infra-pipeline.
maria: +1. Also need follow-up: test harness for latency-sensitive controlplane flows in eBPF presubmit.
leo: created issue INFRA-987: "eBPF QoS: add control-plane bypass and perf tests". Added owners: @maria @ajay.
emily: cost note — GPUs stalled for ~17m total across cluster; estimate ~$1.8k in idle/attach retries across reserved pools in eu-west1. Logging to billing-signal.
ajay: filing incident SEV3 for now, will escalate if leader elections return.
leo: next steps: pause eBPF rollout, backfill bypass across eu-west1, add k8s watch-duration alert to detect this class of regressions.
maria: agree. Also add a periodic check for tc qdisc changes to nodeconfig drift monitor.
emily: good catch everyone, nice fast rollback. :tada:
